name: A False Leads
Text: Play this card whenever the Investigating player has played a card that allows him to search through his deck and add a card to his hand. As soon as he shows you the card, play this card. The card he added is removed from the game, along with this card.

name: A Friend In The FBI
Text: Play this card in the Bureau. Place ten tokens on this card. During your Briefing Phase you may take up to two tokens from this card and place them in your [RP] pool. The tokens become [RP] tokens. When all counters have been removed, discard this card.

name: A Friend In The Lab
Text: Play this card to search through your Bureau Deck and add any one Equipment card to your hand. Show your opponent which card you have added. Discard this card and shuffle your deck.

name: Abduction
Text: Pick one Agent in the Team. That Agent is placed ten cards down, face up, in the owning player's Bureau deck. Any equipment that Agent had is discarded. When the Agent's card reaches the top of the deck, the Agent is immediately moved to the Hospital (undamaged). This card does not initiate Combat.

name: Access Personnel Files
Text: Force an opponent Team to make a COMPUTER 4+ skill check. If they fail, that opponent must tell you the next answer that they obtain regarding the X-File of your choice. The answer need not be a "yes" answer. Discard this card after you've obtained the answer.

name: Additional Resources
Text: Search through your Bureau Deck and select an Agent with a Cost of 4 or less. Add this Agent to your team of Agents in the Bureau section. If this card is negated, remove it as well as the selected Agent from the game. During the Briefing Phase, pay X+1 [RP] upkeep or discard this card and the selected Agent.

name: Agent Alex Krycek
Game Effect: Agent Krycek allows you to choose to add to the Conspiracy Pool instead of the Resource Pool during the Briefing Phase.

name: Agent Dana Scully
Game Effect: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to examine any one Bluff card. Place Bluff card back on the Site after examining.

name: Agent Fox Mulder
Game Effect: [RP]s generated by Agent Mulder must be used to purchase cards. Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to play a Site for zero [RP] cost.

name: Agent Jack Willis
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. Discard a token and look through your Bureau deck to draw any one Site that asks an AFFILIATION question. Add it to your hand. Reshuffle your Bureau Deck.

name: Agent Janus, Trained Medic
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword MEDICAL or HEALING cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase. In addition, if Janus is in the Field Section, he may "heal" one point of damage on another Agent in his Team, once per turn. This may prevent an Agent from going to the Hospital.

name: Agent Jerry Lamana
Game Effect: Once per game, when Agent Lamana is part of a Team investigating a Site in the Investigation Phase, he may force his opponent to show the cards in his hand. Lamana may then steal any one card. He may use it immediately in the investigation. You must still pay for the card. Whether you use it or not, place it in its owner's Discard Pile at the end of the turn.

name: Agent Karen Kosseff, Counselor
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword BEHAVIORAL or OBSERVATION cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase.

name: Agent Lucy Kazdin
Game Effect: If one of your Agents is Abducted, you may immediately draw two cards.

name: Agent Moe Bocks
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase.

name: Agent Nancy Spiller
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword COMPUTER or SCIENCES cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase.

name: Agent Reggie Purdue
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. Discard this token and look through your Bureau deck to draw any one Site that asks a RESULT question. Add it to your hand. Reshuffle your Bureau Deck.

name: Agent Rich
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword EVIDENCE COLLECTION or SUBTERFUGE cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase.

name: Agent Tom Colton
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or BUREAUCRACY cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase.

name: Agent Weiss
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. Discard a token and look through your Bureau deck to draw any one Site that asks a METHOD question. Add it to your hand. Reshuffle your Bureau Deck.

name: Albert Hosteen
Game Effect: Place a token on Hosteen's card. Discard a token to examine your opponent's hand. Select any one Conspiracy card in your opponent's hand show it to your opponent. If your opponent plays that card at any time in the game, you may immediately ask one question about the X-File. This question may only be asked the first time the card is played.

name: Aleister Crowley High School, Milford Haven, NH
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION or one RESULT question.

name: Alien Bounty Hunter
Text: Each source of damage affecting the Alien Bounty Hunter in CLOSE RANGE COMBAT also causes 1 damage to each opposing Team member involved in the Combat (because he has poisonous blood). The Hunter may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE Combat cards. If killed in Combat, place the Hunter back in your deck and shuffle.

name: Alien Discretion
Text: Play on a Team about to investigate a Site with ALIEN INVESTIGATION as a prerequisite. Discard all cards assigned as Bluff cards at that Site. X = the number of Bluffs at the Site.

name: Alien Dna Steroid Program (project Purity Control)
Alien Experimentation
Text: Negate any one Keyword EVENT card.

name: Alien Stealth Technology
Text: Play on any ALIEN combatant to reduce damage from all opponent LONG RANGE COMBAT or CLOSE RANGE COMBAT sources by 1 this round.

name: Ambush
Text: Play this card on any combatant with a SUBTERFUGE skill of 1+ or that is capable of using SUBTERFUGE cards. The opposing side's LONG RANGE COMBAT attack is negated this round.

name: Application For FBI Resources Approved
Text: If the Team makes a BUREAUCRACY 4+ skill check, you may borrow any one of your opponent's Agents. It may not be an Agent you already control. Add the Agent to the Team for the remainder of the turn. Afterward, the Agent returns to the original owner's control. The Agent must be returned to the Team it belonged to or sent to the Hospital if the Agent was reduced to 0 HEALTH during a combat.

name: Arecibo, Puerto Rico
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one METHOD question.

name: Arlington, VA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.

name: Assassinated
Text: Play on any Witness during your opponent's Investigation Phase. The Witness card is negated and removed from the game along with this card. To gain a permanent skill increase of +1 on an investigating team agent, place this card beneath the agent.

name: Assigned To The X-Files
Text: Play to permanently add any one Agent from your hand to a Team. The normal rules for selecting an Agent still apply. In addition, the Agent may not be one that was removed from the game prior to playing this card. X = Agent's Cost.

name: Assistant Director Walter Skinner
Game Effect: Treat Assistant Director Skinner as a RES 3 if he is in the Bureau Section of the table.

name: Aubrey, MO
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.

name: Aura Of Invulnerability
Text: Play on any OCCULT Adversary to reduce damage from all opponent LONG RANGE COMBAT or CLOSE RANGE COMBAT sources by 1 this round.

name: Authorized Access Only
Text: Force an opponent Team to make a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check. If they are not successful, they automatically fail the skill check for the Site.

name: Autopsy
Text: Take a Witness from your Discard Pile and place it in your hand. In addition, if the Team makes a MEDICAL 4+ skill check, the Witness's modifier is doubled if played this turn.

name: Back Tracking Program
Text: Play this card to negate any Keyword COMPUTER card.

name: Baltimore, MD
Question: You may ask one METHOD question or one RESULT question. If you ask if the METHOD is "Threats", the skill check prerequisite is 4+.

name: Bill Mulder
Text: Adds 2 to one Agent's SUBTERFUGE skill check. Alternately, any card that would send Fox Mulder to the Hospital may be negated by playing the Bill Mulder card. If played in this way, remove Bill Mulder from the game.

name: Billy Miles
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Binoculars
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's OBSERVATION skill.

name: Blackmail
Text: Play when you have just guessed incorrectly the identity of an X-File. Select a Team in your Bureau. If that Team successfully completes a BUREAUCRACY 4+ skill check, your opponent does not get to ask you a penalty question.

name: Block
Text: Play this card on any combatant in a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round to reduce the damage from any one source by four points. The combatant using this card does not deal damage in this CRC round.

name: Block and Attack
Text: Combatants that can use MARTIAL ARTS may use this card to negate two points of damage and still deal their normal damage in a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round.

name: Body Armor
Text: Play on any GOVERNMENT Adversary to reduce damage from all opponent LONG RANGE COMBAT or CLOSE RANGE COMBAT sources by one this round.

name: Brad Wilczek
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's COMPUTER skill check.

name: Broad Street, Philadelphia, PA
Question: You may ask one METHOD question.

name: Brother Martin Is Attracted To You
Text: This card does not initiate combat. Place three damage tokens on any Agent in the Investigating Team. The damaged Agent must be moved to the Hospital immediately and heals at half the normal rate. The Agent may not leave the Hospital until all damage is healed, and cannot be removed using other cards (Crash Cart, First Aid, etc.).

name: Browning, MT
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.

name: Byers
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's COMPUTER skill check.

name: Cape Cod, MA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.

name: Car Troubles
Text: Play on a Team of three or more Agents moving to the same Site. The Team may only send two Agents to that Site (owning player's choice). Any extra Agents remain in the Team but may not contribute their skills to any checks this turn. In addition, playing this card will prevent the use of the "Evasive Maneuver" card by this Team this turn.

name: Cellular Phone
Text: The Agent may add his skills to a skill check that is occurring in another Section of the table. The Agent's skill is reduced by one (i.e.; Skill: 3 becomes Skill: 2). LONG RANGE COMBAT and CLOSE RANGE COMBAT may not be added.

name: Central Prison, Raleigh, NC
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one METHOD question. If you ask if the METHOD is "Possession", the skill check prerequisite is 4+.

name: Chaco House, Dudley, AR
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION or one MOTIVE question. If you ask if the MOTIVE is "Security", the skill check prerequisite is 4+.

name: Choke Hold
Text: Play this card on any combatant that can use MARTIAL ARTS. The combatant applies a choke hold. If the combatant causes damage in CLOSE RANGE COMBAT then the damaged Adversary/Agent takes no further part in the combat.

name: Church Of The Red Museum, Delta Glen, WI
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one METHOD question.

name: Cigarette Butts
Text: Basic Game Only: Apply a -2 modifier to any one skill check involving one of the following skills: OCCULT INVESTIGATION, BEHAVIORAL, BUREAUCRACY.Advanced Game: Pay the listed [CP] Cost, where X = the number of [CP] paid to gain the desired modifier to one of the following skills: OCCULT INVESTIGATION, BEHAVIORAL, BUREAUCRACY. (1) = -1, (3) = -2, (5) = -3, (9) = -4.

name: Claude Peterson
Text: Basic Game Only: Apply a -2 modifier to any one skill check involving one of the following skills: CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION, SUBTERFUGE, COMPUTER.Advanced Game: Pay the listed [CP] Cost, where X = the number of [CP] paid to gain the desired modifier to one of the following skills: CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION, SUBTERFUGE, COMPUTER. (1) = -1, (3) = -2, (5) = -3, (9) = -4.

name: Clone
Text: Play this card on any Witness that has just been played. The owning player must shuffle the Witness back into their Bureau deck immediately and does not benefit from the Witness.

name: Coastal Northwest Oregon
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.

name: Colonel Kissell
Text: Negate any one Keyword SCIENCES card.

name: Computer Access Denied
Text: Force an opponent Team to make a COMPUTER 4+ skill check or they will be unable to complete the skill check.

name: Containment Facility, Georgetown, MD
Question: You may ask one RESULT question.

name: Core Training
Text: Play on an Agent in the Bureau. The Agent is taken out of play for one full turn. At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn, the Agent may be deployed as normal, and in addition has a +1 in one of the following skills: CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or EVIDENCE COLLECTION. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.

name: Covering Fire
Text: Play on any GOVERNMENT Adversary to allow it to split the LONG RANGE COMBAT damage it causes amongst its opponents this round.

name: Crew-Cut Man
Text: The chosen Agent is the only one who may participate in the Combat. The Crew-Cut Man may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE cards.

name: Crop Circles
Text: Play after one of your Teams successfully investigates a Site with ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill as a prerequisite. Place this card in your Bureau. Discard this card to add 1 to an ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Cumberland Prison, VA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.

name: Dark Forces Align
Text: Play on an opponent Team in any Section. For the rest of the turn, that Team is considered to have a single Characteristic SITE Keyword (i.e., RESULT SITE). You may choose any one Characteristic for the Keyword.

name: Darkness Falls
Text: Unless a HEALING card is played immediately and the card results in one point being healed, move the Agent to the Hospital. The Agent must stay in the Hospital for the next turn.

name: Deadhorse, AK
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one RESULT question. If you ask if the RESULT is "Manipulation Of Evidence", the skill check prerequisite is 4+.

name: Deadly Blur
Text: Any Agent damaged by the Deadly Blur is placed in the Hospital for the next two turns regardless of how much HEALTH they have. Each opponent's LONG RANGE COMBAT and CLOSE RANGE COMBAT is reduced by one point. The Deadly Blur may use SUBTERFUGE Combat cards.

name: Decoy
Text: Play when an Adversary is allowed to enter combat with a single Agent. If the Team to which the Agent is attached makes a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check, the Adversary is negated.

name: Decreased Workload
Text: Play during the Briefing Phase. One Team in the Bureau may make a BUREAUCRACY 4+ skill check. If successful, choose one Agent. The Agent now has a RES number equal to the Agent's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill during the next Briefing Phase. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.

name: Deductive Reasoning
Text: Play on a Team that has just completed a combat. If the Team makes a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 5+ skill check, then they may ask whether or not the Adversary has a Keyword that is the same as the AFFILIATION of the controller's X-File.

name: Detective Frank Briggs
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Detective Kelly Ryan
Text: Play to change one Keyword EVIDENCE COLLECTION, BEHAVIORAL, or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION card to Keyword MOTIVE.

name: Detective Miles
Text: Pay 1 [CP] to move up to 2 [RP] from your opponent's [RP] pool to your [CP] pool immediately.

name: Detective Sharon Lazard
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check.

name: Detective Thompson
Text: Play to change a Site Prerequisite to BUREAUCRACY 3+.

name: Detective Tony Fiore
Text: Play to cause your opponent to discard two cards at random from his hand immediately.

name: Disarm
Text: Adversaries that can use MARTIAL ARTS may play this card in a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round to cause one Equipment card from the opposing side to be discarded. If the Equipment normally adds to CRC skill check, then it is discarded before it may do so.

name: Dissection
Text: Play this card after a Team of Agents damages an Adversary in combat by dealing enough wounds to kill it. Place five tokens in the [RP] pool.

name: Dodge
Text: Play this card on any combatant in a LONG RANGE COMBAT round to reduce the damage from any one source by four points. The combatant using this card does not deal damage in this LRC round.

name: Doug Spinney
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's SCIENCES skill check.

name: Dr. Aaron Monte
Text: Play to change one Keyword EVIDENCE COLLECTION, MEDICAL, or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION card to Keyword MOTIVE.

name: Dr. Berube
Text: Basic Game Only: Apply a -2 modifier to any one skill check involving one of the following skills: ALIEN INVESTIGATION, MEDICAL, SCIENCES.Advanced Game: Pay the listed [CP] Cost, where X = the number of [CP] paid to gain the desired modifier to one of the following skills: ALIEN INVESTIGATION, MEDICAL, SCIENCES. (1) = -1, (3) = -2, (5) = -3, (9) = -4.

name: Dr. Blockhead
Text: Negates one EVOLUTIONARY CREATURE.

name: Dr. Charles Burk
Game Effect: Place one token on this card. Discard a token to negate one OCCULT Adversary.

name: Dr. Daniel Trepkos
Text: Negates one PRIMORDIAL CREATURE.

name: Dr. Davey
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's SCIENCES skill check.

name: Dr. Diamond
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL skill check once during your turn.

name: Dr. Hodge
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's MEDICAL skill check.

name: Dr. Joe Ridley
Text: Negate any one Keyword MEDICAL card.

name: Dr. Laskos
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's MEDICAL skill check.

name: Dr. Sheila Braun
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL skill check.

name: Driving
Text: Play on a Team in the Field during the Deployment Phase. If the Team makes a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 5+ skill check, they may investigate two Sites in the same state this turn.

name: Electron Emission Microscope
Text: Agents equipped with an Electron Emission Microscope have access to the field office crime lab. Adds 1 to the Agent's MEDICAL skill.

name: Ellens Air Base, ID
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.

name: Emil and Zoe
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's OBSERVATION skill check.

name: Energy Strike
Text: Play on any ALIEN or EVOLUTIONARY Adversary to add 3 to any LONG RANGE COMBAT skill check. If the Adversary does not have LRC skill, this card gives it a 3 for this round only.

name: Equipment Malfunction
Text: Force one opponent to discard one piece of equipment (your choice) that does not specifically modify LONG or CLOSE RANGE COMBAT.

name: Eurisko Building, Crystal City, VA
Question: You may ask one METHOD question or one RESULT question. If you ask if the RESULT is "Abduction", the skill check prerequisite is 4+.

name: Evasive Maneuvers
Text: Negate one non-PHENOMENA Adversary.

name: Eve 7
Text: Move any Bluff cards from one Site to another Site or back into the owner's hand. If at the end of an Investigation Phase a Site is left with no Bluffs attached, discard it. X = 1 [CP] per Bluff removed.

name: Evidence Destroyed
Text: Negate one Keyword EVIDENCE COLLECTION card.

name: Evidence Overlooked
Text: If the Team makes an OBSERVATION 4+ skill check, they gain a +1 to the Site skill check. Discard this card after you've used the modifier.

name: Excelsius Dei Convalescent Home, Worcester, MA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one METHOD question. If you ask if the MOTIVE is "Security", the skill check prerequisite is 4+.

name: Expedite Request For Resources
Text: Play on a Team in the Bureau. If the Team makes a BUREAUCRACY 4+ skill check then you may search through your Bureau Deck and draw one Equipment card to add to your hand. Show the card to your opponents and then shuffle your deck.

name: Expert Briefing
Text: Play on an Agent in the Bureau. The Agent is taken out of play for one full turn. At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn the Agent may be deployed as normal and in addition has a +1 in one of the following skills: OBSERVATION, BEHAVIORAL or SUBTERFUGE. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.

name: Explosion
Text: Play this card to cause one point of damage to every Agent in a Team for each [CP] Cost card discarded from your hand, up to a maximum of three points of damage. X = number of [CP] Cost cards discarded.

name: F. Emasculata Outbreak
Text: This card does not initiate combat. Play this card in the Investigating Player's Hospital section. Place three tokens on this card. Remove one token in the Debriefing Phase of your opponent's turn. This card is discarded when the last token is removed. Agents may not heal as long as this card is in their Hospital section.

name: Face-Off
Text: Play this card during a LONG RANGE COMBAT round on a combatant you control with an LRC skill. That combatant and one other combatant of the owning player's choice will deal no damage in this LRC round.

name: Fairfield Zoo, Fairfield, ID
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.

name: Farmington, NM
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one METHOD question. If you ask if the METHOD is "Manipulation", the skill check prerequisite is 4+.

name: Fascination
Text: Play on any Adversary to add 1 to its CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill check. In addition, if the Adversary is OCCULT, play on the chosen Agent in combat to negate his combat skills this round.

name: Fast Draw
Text: Play on any one combatant who would not normally be allowed to fight a round of LONG RANGE COMBAT. The combatant must still have LRC skill. The combatant may fight one round of LRC as normal.

name: Fast Strike
Text: Play this card on any combatant with a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill of three or more to allow that combatant to attack twice in a CRC round.

name: Fingernail Scrapings
Text: If the Team makes an EVIDENCE COLLECTION 4+ skill check, they gain a +1 to a Site skill check. Discard this card after you've used the modifier.

name: Fingerprints
Text: Play on one Team in the Field. If the Team makes an EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check 5+, then they may add 2 to any Site skill check. Discard this card after you've used the modifier.

name: First Aid
Text: Play on any Agent in the Field to immediately Heal one point of damage.

name: Flaming Wall
Text: Play on any EVOLUTIONARY Adversary to cause one point of damage to each opponent in a LONG RANGE COMBAT round. This is in addition to any other damage caused by the Adversary in this round.

name: Folkstone, NC
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one MOTIVE question.

name: Franklin, PA
Question: You may ask one METHOD question.

name: Frohike
Text: This card will negate one Event card played on your Team.

name: Gas Chromatograph
Text: Agents equipped with a Gas Chromatograph have access to the field office crime lab. Adds 1 to the Agent's SCIENCES skill.

name: Geiger Counter
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill.

name: Genetics Clinic, Marin County, CA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.

name: Gerd Thomas
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's OBSERVATION skill check.

name: Ghost in the Machine
Text: Play to change one Keyword COMPUTER, SCIENCES, or SUBTERFUGE card to Keyword RESULT.

name: Gibsonton, FL
Question: You may ask one METHOD question.

name: Glock 19 Semi-Automatic Pistol
Text: Adds 2 to the Agent's LONG RANGE COMBAT skill.

name: Good People, Good Food
Text: Damage caused by this creature may be split among all opponents (Directed Player's choice).

name: Government Arrests Suspects
Text: Negate one Witness that modifies ALIEN INVESTIGATION or BUREAUCRACY skill.

name: Government Car
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill.

name: Government Cover-Up
Text: Basic Game Only: Apply a -2 modifier to any one skill check involving one of the following skills: SCIENCES, EVIDENCE COLLECTION, BUREAUCRACY.Advanced Game: Pay the listed [CP] Cost, where X = the number of [CP] paid to gain the desired modifier to one of the following skills: SCIENCES, EVIDENCE COLLECTION, BUREAUCRACY. (1) = -1, (3) = -2, (5) = -3, (9) = -4.

name: Government Mindwipe Serum
Text: Force one opponent to discard all cards in their hand that contain the Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION or BUREAUCRACY.

name: Government Sanctioned Pheromone Experiments
Text: Force an opponent Team to make a SCIENCES 4+ skill check. If the Team fails, you may choose an opposing Agent on the Team to enter combat with any other Agent on the Team. Combat will only last one round.

name: Grid Pattern Search
Text: Select one card from your Discard Pile and place it in your hand.

name: Gun Jammed
Text: Negates the effects of any one Equipment card that adds to LONG RANGE COMBAT Skill for the duration of this combat.

name: Gung Bituen
Text: Attach this Witness to a Team. Enables your Agents to deal damage to OCCULT CREATUREs as normal. For example, you may use LRC against POLTERGEISTs and VAMPIREs. If at any time there are no Agents in the Team to which this card is attached, discard this card.

name: Handcuff
Text: Play this card in a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round after damage has been dealt. If the Agents dealt two or more points more damage than their opponent, combat ends immediately. In addition, place the opposing Adversary in the Agents' Bureau section. The player may discard this card at any time to add two points of damage to any future combat involving an Adversary with the same Keywords.

name: Hard Evidence
Text: Add five tokens to your [RP] pool.

name: Hard Punch
Text: Play on any combatant in a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round. Add one to the combatant's damage result.

name: Harry Cokely
Text: Play to change one Keyword OCCULT INVESTIGATION, BEHAVIORAL, or OBSERVATION card to Keyword METHOD.

name: Hazardous Sample
Text: Play to force the Investigating player to discard all Keyword EVIDENCE COLLECTION cards in his hand.

name: Henry Trondheim
Text: Force the Team investigation a Site to discard one Equipment card of your choice.

name: Hidden Grave
Text: Take any Witness from your opponent's Discard Pile and use it for one skill check immediately at no cost.

name: Hidden Transmitter
Text: Play after an opponent Team successfully asks a Characteristic question. Force that opponent Team to make a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check. If they fail they must tell you the question and answer they obtained.

name: Hide
Text: Play this on one combatant with a SUBTERFUGE skill of 1+ or that is capable of using SUBTERFUGE cards. No damage may be dealt to that combatant in this round and the combatant deals no damage.

name: High Resolution Camera
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill.

name: High-Powered Flashlight
Text: Adds 2 to the Agent's OBSERVATION skill.

name: Hit and Run
Text: One Agent equipped with a "Government Car" may use this card to make one CLOSE RANGE COMBAT attack at CRC skill: 6. Any damage allocated to the Agent is taken by the car first. The car is destroyed after taking six hits. Hits in excess of those needed to destroy the car are applied to the Agent. Discard the "Government Car" card after this combat round is resolved.

name: Holtzman, D.S.A.
Text: Basic Game Only: Apply a -2 modifier to any one skill check involving one of the following skills: CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION, EVIDENCE COLLECTION, COMPUTER.Advanced Game: Pay the listed [CP] Cost, where X = the number of [CP] paid to gain the desired modifier to one of the following skills: CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION, EVIDENCE COLLECTION, COMPUTER. (1) = -1, (3) = -2, (5) = -3, (9) = -4.

name: Hospital Crash Cart
Text: This piece of Equipment does not need to be attached to any Agent. Place three tokens on the Hospital Crash Cart. Discard one token to heal one point of damage to an Agent in the Hospital. Discard when all three tokens have been expended.

name: Hunter In The Dark
Text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped.

name: I Want To Believe
Text: Play on one Agent to allow that Agent to use their EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill number for any one ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Icy Cape, AK
Question: You may ask one RESULT question.

name: Illusionary Foe
Text: Play on any OCCULT or EVOLUTIONARY Adversary to negate all damage allocated to that Adversary this round.

name: Improved Channels
Text: The Team must make a BUREAUCRACY 4+ skill check. If successful, you may now have up to ten cards in hand at the end of your turn. This condition stays in effect until you are forced to discard this card. Discard this card if one of your Agents is moved from or to the Bureau Section of the table for any reason.

name: In-Service Training
